svg.title: PolySocial · Events open to some sections (#369)
svg.desc: Create event with the sections picker, open to all and restricted, and the event detail pill. A proposal to redraw in Figma.
svg.text: PolySocial · #369 · proposal drawn outside Figma, to redraw there and review

g.text: Create event · public · open to all sections
Title, date, place and the rest of the form stay as they are.
Not on the map. You approve each person.
Shown on the map to every student.
Open to all sections. Pick sections to limit who can see it.
Create event · public · restricted to IN, SC
Title, date, place and the rest of the form stay as they are.
Not on the map. You approve each person.
Shown on the map to every student.
Only students in IN, SC can see it.
Event detail · restricted to IN, SC
Bring your favourite game, or learn a new one.
• Create and Edit event, after Visibility: a Sections row. One chip
per EPFL section, none picked = open to all sections.
• The caption says which it is, so the empty choice is never
ambiguous: "Open to all sections…" or "Only students in IN, SC…".
• Shown for a student's public event only. A private event or an
association's has no restriction, so the row is hidden.
• Making an event private hides the row and saves it open to all;
public again brings back what was picked.
• Edit event: the same row, filled with the stored sections.
• Event detail: a grey pill next to the category, "Only IN, SC";
more than three sections: "Only IN, SC, MA +2".
• Students outside the sections never see the event: it is not in
the map or Events, and its link says "not found".
• Organizers see it whatever their own section.
• Chips reuse the interest chips of the profile step.
